notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result "dragon-age-4-tba" (id 274764, released 2024-10-31) matches the expected slug; RAWG also has a separate entry with the slug "dragon-age-the-veilguard" titled "Dragon Age: The Dreadwolf". No StrategyWiki page under "Dragon Age: The Veilguard" or "Dragon Age: Dreadwolf". dragonage.fandom.com answers the API under "Dragon Age: The Veilguard" ("Dragon Age: Dreadwolf" redirects there), with about 186 linked pages, including "Rook", "Minrathous", "Arlathan Forest", "Treviso", "Quests (The Veilguard)" and companion pages such as "Lace Harding", "Davrin" and "Taash"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Morrison(Game Jam)" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 1845910 as "Dragon Age™: The Veilguard". 43 of 52 Steam achievements are hidden. The 14 "Part N" achievements name the story parts, so they set the three story chapters (split by part number). The other 29 hidden ones sit in the hidden milestones chapter; they include six "A Memory of..." achievements, "A Rook Likes Shiny Things" and its follow-up, and four that follow Part 14 in the Steam list ("The Ones That Last", "The Storm Quelled", "In Peace", "No Real Gods") with lower rates, which may be endings; many others are probably companion or faction quests, but the data does not say. "A Most Esteemed Purveyor" (an invitation) sits with gear and merchants.
